class.name: HTMLPrintLayout
class.brief_description: A paginated print layout created from an [HTMLDocument].
class.description: The print layout waits for remote stylesheets and images before emitting [signal ready]. Page sizes and content rectangles are expressed in CSS pixels. Pagination honors [code]break-before[/code], [code]break-after[/code], and legacy [code]page-break-before[/code] and [code]page-break-after[/code] values that force a page break. It currently does not apply [code]break-inside[/code], column break values, [code]orphans[/code], or [code]widows[/code]. Page-specific content widths share one text reflow width. PDF export writes basic text, rectangular fills, circles, and images as PDF objects. Text is written with PDF standard Helvetica; glyphs it cannot encode, including CJK glyphs, are omitted. Some CSS transforms, overflow clips, and compositing effects are reported in [method get_diagnostics] and are not preserved.

signal.name: ready
signal.description: Emitted after layout and remote resource requests have finished. Check [method get_error] and [method get_diagnostics] before exporting.

method.name: get_diagnostics
method.description: Returns print layout, resource, and PDF export limitations collected so far.

method.name: get_error
method.description: Returns the most recent Godot error code, or [constant OK] when the layout and last export succeeded.

method.name: get_error_message
method.description: Returns a message for the most recent layout or export error.

method.name: get_page_content_rect
method.description: Returns the printable content rectangle within a page in CSS pixels.

method.name: get_page_count
method.description: Returns the number of pages in this layout.

method.name: get_page_size
method.description: Returns the physical page size in CSS pixels.

method.name: is_ready
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] after the initial layout and all remote resources have settled.

method.name: save_pdf
method.description: Exports the paginated layout to a PDF file. Returns [constant OK] on success. PDF export requires a build with the PDFium writer backend.

method.name: to_pdf
method.description: Exports the paginated layout to PDF bytes. Returns an empty array when the layout is not ready or PDFium is unavailable.
